subject: math
title: Quadratic roots
body: Sum = −b/a, product = c/a, D = b² − 4ac. D>0 real distinct, D=0 equal, D<0 complex conjugates.

subject: math
title: Symmetric functions of roots
body:
α²+β² = (α+β)² − 2αβ
α³+β³ = (α+β)³ − 3αβ(α+β)
(α−β)² = (α+β)² − 4αβ

subject: math
title: Logarithms
body:
log(ab)=log a+log b · log(a/b)=log a−log b · log aⁿ = n log a
Change of base: logₐb = ln b / ln a = 1/log_b a
a^(log_a x) = x

subject: math
title: A.P. / G.P.
body:
A.P.: aₙ = a+(n−1)d, Sₙ = n/2 [2a+(n−1)d]
G.P.: aₙ = arⁿ⁻¹, Sₙ = a(rⁿ−1)/(r−1), S∞ = a/(1−r) for |r|<1

subject: math
title: Binomial theorem
body:
General term T(r+1) = ⁿCᵣ aⁿ⁻ʳ bʳ · n+1 terms
Sum of coefficients: put x = 1 · alternating: put x = −1
Middle term: n even → T(n/2+1); n odd → two middle terms

subject: math
title: Permutations & combinations
body:
ⁿPᵣ = n!/(n−r)! · ⁿCᵣ = n!/(r!(n−r)!) · ⁿCᵣ = ⁿCₙ₋ᵣ
Circular: (n−1)! · Repeated letters: n!/(p!q!…)
Subsets of n-set: 2ⁿ

subject: math
title: Complex numbers
body:
|z|² = z·z̄ · iⁿ cycles 1, i, −1, −i (use n mod 4)
1+ω+ω² = 0, ω³ = 1 · De Moivre: (cosθ+i sinθ)ⁿ = cos nθ + i sin nθ

subject: math
title: Inequalities / modulus
body: |x|<a ⇔ −a<x<a · |x|>a ⇔ x<−a or x>a · Always flip the sign when multiplying by a negative.

subject: math
title: Double-angle
body:
sin2θ = 2sinθcosθ
cos2θ = cos²θ − sin²θ = 2cos²θ − 1 = 1 − 2sin²θ
tan2θ = 2tanθ/(1 − tan²θ)

subject: math
title: Compound angle
body:
sin(A±B) = sinAcosB ± cosAsinB
cos(A±B) = cosAcosB ∓ sinAsinB
tan(A±B) = (tanA ± tanB)/(1 ∓ tanA tanB)

subject: math
title: Sum-to-product
body:
sinC + sinD = 2 sin((C+D)/2) cos((C−D)/2)
cosC + cosD = 2 cos((C+D)/2) cos((C−D)/2)
cosC − cosD = −2 sin((C+D)/2) sin((C−D)/2)

subject: math
title: General solutions
body:
sinθ=0 → nπ · cosθ=0 → (2n+1)π/2 · tanθ=0 → nπ
sinθ=sinα → θ = nπ + (−1)ⁿα · cosθ=cosα → θ = 2nπ ± α

subject: math
title: Derivative table
body:
(xⁿ)′=nxⁿ⁻¹ · (eˣ)′=eˣ · (aˣ)′=aˣ ln a · (ln x)′=1/x
(sin)′=cos · (cos)′=−sin · (tan)′=sec² · (cot)′=−csc² · (sec)′=sec tan
(sin⁻¹x)′=1/√(1−x²) · (tan⁻¹x)′=1/(1+x²)

subject: math
title: Differentiation rules
body:
Product: (uv)′=u′v+uv′ · Quotient: (u/v)′=(u′v−uv′)/v² · Chain: f(g)′ = f′(g)g′
xˣ-type: take ln of both sides, then differentiate.

subject: math
title: Integral table
body:
∫xⁿ = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) · ∫1/x = ln|x| · ∫eˣ = eˣ
∫tan x = ln|sec x| · ∫sec x = ln|sec x+tan x|
∫1/(a²+x²) = (1/a)tan⁻¹(x/a) · ∫1/√(a²−x²) = sin⁻¹(x/a)

subject: math
title: Integration shortcuts
body:
By parts: ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du, pick u by ILATE (Inverse, Log, Algebraic, Trig, Exp)
∫eˣ[f(x)+f′(x)] dx = eˣ f(x) + C
sin²x = (1−cos2x)/2, cos²x = (1+cos2x)/2

subject: math
title: Definite integral tricks
body:
Odd f over [−a,a] → 0 · Even f → 2∫₀ᵃ
∫₀ᵃ f(x)dx = ∫₀ᵃ f(a−x)dx
∫₀ᵃ f(x)/(f(x)+f(a−x)) dx = a/2   (e.g. ∫₀^(π/2) sinx/(sinx+cosx) = π/4)

subject: math
title: Limits
body:
sin x/x → 1 · (eˣ−1)/x → 1 · ln(1+x)/x → 1 · (1+1/x)ˣ → e as x→∞
(xⁿ−aⁿ)/(x−a) → n aⁿ⁻¹ · 0/0 or ∞/∞ → L’Hôpital.

subject: math
title: Maxima / minima
body: f′(x)=0 for critical points. f″>0 → minimum, f″<0 → maximum. Sum fixed → product max when equal.

subject: math
title: Determinant facts
body:
|AB| = |A||B| · |kA| = kⁿ|A| · |Aᵀ| = |A| · |A⁻¹| = 1/|A| · |adj A| = |A|ⁿ⁻¹
Swapping two rows flips the sign; two equal rows → 0.

subject: math
title: Inverse / transpose
body:
A⁻¹ = adj A / |A| (2×2: swap diagonal, negate off-diagonal, divide by det)
(AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ · (AB)⁻¹ = B⁻¹A⁻¹ · A·adj A = |A| I

subject: math
title: Systems of equations
body: Cramer: x = Dₓ/D. |A|≠0 → unique solution. |A|=0 → none or infinitely many.

subject: math
title: Line formulas
body:
Distance = √(Δx²+Δy²) · Section (m:n) = ((mx₂+nx₁)/(m+n), …)
Slope-intercept y=mx+c · Distance from (x₁,y₁) to ax+by+c=0: |ax₁+by₁+c|/√(a²+b²)
Parallel m₁=m₂ · Perpendicular m₁m₂=−1 · Triangle area = ½|x₁(y₂−y₃)+x₂(y₃−y₁)+x₃(y₁−y₂)|

subject: math
title: Circle
body:
Centre (h,k), radius r: (x−h)²+(y−k)²=r²
x²+y²+2gx+2fy+c=0 → centre (−g,−f), r = √(g²+f²−c)
Line y=mx+c touches x²+y²=r² when c² = r²(1+m²)

subject: math
title: Conics
body:
Parabola y²=4ax: focus (a,0), directrix x=−a, latus rectum 4a, e=1
Ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1: b²=a²(1−e²), foci (±ae,0), e<1
Hyperbola x²/a²−y²/b²=1: b²=a²(e²−1), e>1

subject: math
title: Products
body:
a·b = |a||b|cosθ = a₁b₁+a₂b₂+a₃b₃ · a⊥b ⇔ a·b=0
|a×b| = |a||b|sinθ · area of triangle = ½|a×b| · parallelogram = |a×b|
Projection of a on b = a·b/|b| · i×j=k, j×k=i, k×i=j

subject: math
title: Rules
body:
P(A∪B) = P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B) · P(A|B) = P(A∩B)/P(B)
Independent: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B) · P(not A) = 1−P(A) · Bayes: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B)

subject: math
title: Option elimination
body: Plug in x = 0, 1, −1 into the options before solving. Check dimensions/signs/limits. For “find the value” with 4 numbers, back-substitute.

subject: math
title: Timing (suggested)
body: Paper: 200 MCQs / 180 min = 54 s each. Aim ≈ 45 s for Math basics, bank time for the hard ones. Skip anything > 90 s and flag it; return in the last 20 minutes.

subject: phy
title: Kinematics
body: v = u + at · s = ut + ½at² · v² = u² + 2as · s_nth = u + a(n − ½)

subject: phy
title: Projectile
body: T = 2u sinθ/g · H = u² sin²θ / 2g · R = u² sin2θ / g · max range at 45° · R(θ) = R(90°−θ)

subject: phy
title: Newton & friction
body: F = ma = dp/dt · f ≤ μN · on incline a = g(sinθ − μcosθ) · Banking: tanθ = v²/rg

subject: phy
title: Circular motion
body: a = v²/r = ω²r · F = mv²/r · v = ωr · T = 2π/ω · vertical circle minimum speed at top √(gr), at bottom √(5gr)

subject: phy
title: Work, energy, power
body: W = Fd cosθ · KE = ½mv² · PE = mgh · P = W/t = Fv · Work-energy: W_net = ΔKE

subject: phy
title: Momentum & collisions
body:
p = mv · Elastic: v₁′ = [(m₁−m₂)v₁ + 2m₂v₂]/(m₁+m₂) · Perfectly inelastic: v = (m₁v₁+m₂v₂)/(m₁+m₂)
Equal masses elastic → velocities exchange.

subject: phy
title: Rotation
body:
τ = Iα = r×F · L = Iω · KE_rot = ½Iω² · I: ring MR², disc ½MR², solid sphere ⅖MR², rod (centre) ML²/12
Parallel axis I = I_cm + Md²

subject: phy
title: Gravitation
body: F = Gm₁m₂/r² · g = GM/R² · v_orbit = √(GM/r) · v_escape = √(2GM/R) = √2 v_orbit · T² ∝ r³

subject: phy
title: SHM
body:
ω = √(k/m) · T = 2π√(m/k) · pendulum T = 2π√(L/g)
v = ω√(A²−x²) · a = −ω²x · E = ½kA²

subject: phy
title: Waves & sound
body:
v = fλ · string v = √(T/μ) · closed pipe f = (2n−1)v/4L · open pipe f = nv/2L
Beats = |f₁−f₂| · Doppler f′ = f (v ± v_o)/(v ∓ v_s)  (approach → higher)

subject: phy
title: Ray & wave optics
body:
Lens/mirror: 1/f = 1/p + 1/q · m = −q/p · Snell n₁sinθ₁ = n₂sinθ₂ · sinθc = n₂/n₁
YDSE fringe width β = λD/d · Grating d sinθ = nλ · Single slit minima a sinθ = nλ

subject: phy
title: Gas laws & thermo
body:
PV = nRT · KE per molecule = (3/2)kT · v_rms = √(3RT/M) · ΔU = Q − W · adiabatic PVᵞ = const
Q = mcΔT · Carnot η = 1 − T_c/T_h (kelvin!)

subject: phy
title: Electrostatics
body:
F = kq₁q₂/r² · E = kq/r² · V = kq/r · W = qΔV · C = ε₀A/d · U = ½CV²
Parallel C = ΣC · series 1/C = Σ(1/C) · Gauss: Φ = q/ε₀ · field inside conductor = 0

subject: phy
title: Current electricity
body:
V = IR · R = ρL/A · P = VI = I²R = V²/R · series R = ΣR · parallel 1/R = Σ(1/R)
Terminal voltage V = ε − Ir · Kirchhoff: ΣI = 0 at junction, ΣV = 0 in a loop · Two resistors in parallel R = R₁R₂/(R₁+R₂)

subject: phy
title: Magnetism & induction
body:
F = qvB sinθ · F = BIL sinθ · r = mv/qB · B (long wire) = μ₀I/2πr · solenoid B = μ₀nI
ε = −dΦ/dt · motional ε = BLv · Lenz: induced current opposes the change

subject: phy
title: AC circuits
body: V_rms = V₀/√2 · X_L = ωL · X_C = 1/ωC · Z = √(R²+(X_L−X_C)²) · resonance f = 1/(2π√LC) · transformer V_s/V_p = N_s/N_p

subject: phy
title: Quantum & atom
body:
E = hf = hc/λ · KEmax = hf − φ · eV₀ = KEmax · λ = h/p · Bohr Eₙ = −13.6/n² eV
Spectral lines: 1/λ = R(1/n₁² − 1/n₂²) · Intensity changes photocurrent, not KEmax.

subject: phy
title: Nuclear
body: N = N₀(½)^(t/T½) · T½ = 0.693/λ · E = Δm c² · 1 u = 931.5 MeV · α = He nucleus, β = electron, γ = photon

subject: phy
title: Fluids / elasticity
body: P = P₀ + ρgh · A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ · Bernoulli: P + ½ρv² + ρgh = const · Young Y = stress/strain · buoyancy = ρVg

subject: phy
title: Dimension check
body: Wrong dimensions → wrong option. Convert units first (cm→m, μF→F, eV→J). Use g = 10 only if told or if the options are clean.

subject: eng
title: Subject–verb agreement
body:
Singular: each, every, either, neither, one of, news, mathematics. With either/or, neither/nor the verb agrees with the NEARER subject.
Collective nouns: singular if acting as a unit.

subject: eng
title: Tenses & time words
body: since + point in time, for + duration (present perfect). By next year → will have + V3. When/After the past event → past perfect for the earlier action.

subject: eng
title: Conditionals
body:
Zero: if + present, present · First: if + present, will · Second: if + past (were), would · Third: if + had V3, would have V3.
Inverted: Had I known…, Were I you…, Should you need…

subject: eng
title: Prepositions to memorise
body: senior/junior/superior/inferior to · good at · interested in · afraid of · different from · prefer X to Y · look forward to + -ing · capable of · aware of · accuse of

subject: eng
title: Common traps
body: fewer (countable) / less (uncountable) · affect (v) / effect (n) · its / it’s · who (subject) / whom (object) · among (3+) / between (2) · a honest → an honest.

subject: eng
title: Parallelism & modifiers
body: List items must share form (swimming, running, cycling). A modifying phrase must sit next to what it describes: “Walking home, I saw…” not “Walking home, the tree…”.

subject: eng
title: Punctuation (SAT-style)
body: Semicolon joins two complete sentences. Comma + FANBOYS joins two complete sentences. Never splice with only a comma. Colon follows a complete clause. Apostrophe = possession/contraction, never plural.

subject: eng
title: Voice & reported speech
body: Active→Passive: object becomes subject, be + V3. Reported speech back-shifts: am→was, will→would, now→then, today→that day.

subject: eng
title: High-yield roots
body: bene = good (benevolent) · mal = bad (malevolent) · ambi = both (ambiguous) · ced/cess = go (precede) · chron = time (chronic) · dict = say (verdict) · loqu = speak (eloquent) · omni = all (omnipresent) · ped = foot · phil = love · spec = look (scrutinize)

subject: eng
title: Answering synonym/antonym
body: Read the word in context first. Check whether the question asks for synonym or ANTONYM before choosing. Eliminate options with the opposite tone (positive/negative charge).

subject: eng
title: Sentence completion
body: Predict the missing word BEFORE reading options. Signals: “despite/although/but” → contrast; “therefore/so/thus” → same direction.

subject: eng
title: Time (suggested)
body: 40 questions ≈ 25 min. English is the fastest 20% of the paper — treat it as guaranteed marks and protect accuracy.
